S.FORM: alang Hbun-Rangay ga niya mki sku Sincik Keng atu Nahuy go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 108 buwan, 293 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 89% kyan ku 262 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 11% kyan ku 31 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 88%, binah lihuyan s'uli 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ru kyokay. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Hbun-Rangay hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Hbun-Rangay hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Hbun-Rangay hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Hbun-Rangay hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Hbun-Rangay hya' ga Mkslaq. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ ħβunraŋaj ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]ik keŋ atu naħuj ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ru kjokaj rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na ħβunraŋaj ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na ħβunraŋaj ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na ħβunraŋaj ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na ħβunraŋaj ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na ħβunraŋaj ħjaʔ ɣa mk[s|ɕ]laq reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
